Reliance Bets on Digital Astrology Growth with JioAstro Launch
items.snippet: Reliance-backed Jio Platforms has developed an artificial intelligence-based Vedic astrology platform, JioAstro, focusing on India’s growing digital astrology sector. The service provides customised Kundali, horoscope, birth chart, Panchang and Yoga and Dosha identification in four languages.

items.title: S&P Global in Talks with Cognizant to Outsource Parts of Capital IQ Operations
items.snippet: Cognisant is in talks to acquire elements of S&P Global’s Capital IQ business, which might affect 1,500 employees at the latter’s India global capabilities center, reports said. The development illustrates rising outsourcing trends as organisations seek to reduce costs and boost efficiency with AI.

items.title: Wipro Expands Global Operations with Takeover of 3,000 BP Finance Employees
items.snippet: A transaction is anticipated to see more than 3,000 BP financial employees in India, Hungary and Malaysia move to Wipro, with staff transitioning in 2027. The cooperation would enable BP to decrease costs and reduce debt, while Wipro will handle the staff and financial operations.
